verses.verse:
फूत्कारों वैकृतः श्रेष्ठः प्राकृतो मध्यम स्मृतः।
जड़ाश्रितस्तु फूत्कारो दोष यक्तोऽधमो भवेत्।६६।
verses.text: Cultivated blowing is the best; natural blowing is held to be middling; blowing that relies on an inert device is faulty and is the lowest.

commentary.text: Whatever the kind of blowing, the cause of nādotpatti (the production of sound) in the bānsurī is only the friction of air. When moving air strikes, many kinds of vibration begin in the still air. Differences in the fixed width and length of the air bring rise and fall in the sound. This very rise and fall is given the name sargam (the scale of notes). The following śloka says just this.

subsection.title: Practice of the Tongue and of the Fingers
